tagline: Self-hosted anime and manga media server (rootless)
description:
Seanime is an open-source media server with a web interface and desktop
app for anime and manga. It integrates with AniList, manages your local
library, streams and downloads episodes, and plays them with your media
player of choice.

This package uses the rootless image (umagistr/seanime:latest-rootless),
which runs as the non-root user seanime (UID 1000) for improved security.
author: restuindrawan

tips.before_install:
Rootless image: Seanime runs as UID:GID 1000:1000 by default. An
init step fixes ownership of the config and downloads folders on
every start, and never touches your anime files. If the scan
shows an empty library, your media is probably owned by another
user. On the Zima box run `ls -ln /DATA/Media/Anime`, then set
PUID to the folder owner's UID and PGID to its GID at install.
Adjust the anime and downloads paths during install if your
library lives elsewhere.

Publishing outside your LAN: set a server password first. Seanime's
docs require server.password when the server is reachable from
outside this machine. Set SEANIME_SERVER_PASSWORD during install,
or edit config.toml in the config folder after the first start and
set password under [server], then restart. A password is not
encryption: prefer a VPN such as Tailscale or an HTTPS reverse
proxy over forwarding plain HTTP port 3211 on your router.

title: Seanime
release_note: Fix rootless permissions. A one-shot helper makes config and downloads writable by Seanime's UID/GID, and PUID/PGID let you match the media owner's UID/GID when scans show an empty library. Host port 3211 forwards to container port 43211, with SEANIME_SERVER_HOST=0.0.0.0 and optional SEANIME_SERVER_PASSWORD.
